notes: Raw measurements are never rewritten. Large text tables/logs use lossless deterministic gzip; original/stored hashes are both retained.
No executable, archive, build object, unrelated project, userdata cache or original research is committed.
baseline-sampled900 is a watch-tour control with different gameplay. It is excluded from the matched unchanged stationary workload.
baseline-wasd900 records a source-stability rejection due to concurrent header editing; its frozen binary physics is useful context, not clean-source timing acceptance.
parity900 and negative-probe900 contain diagnostic engine instrumentation and are not normal performance comparisons.
The original export refusal and corrected export follow-up have separate receipts. The final commit identity is linked and exported after checkpointing without changing the qualified core.
All raw logs and process maps are compressed losslessly, including their original trailing whitespace; source and evidence bytes are not trimmed for diff checks.
